record.paper_title: Open problems in some competition models
record.context_brief: Ricker second boundary exclusion fixed point
record.original_question: For the two-species Ricker competition system x_{n+1}=x_n e^{K-x_n-a y_n}, y_{n+1}=y_n e^{L-y_n-b x_n} with K,L>0 and a,b∈(0,1), determine the stability type of the exclusion fixed point (0,L) in the boundary case L=2 and L=K/a, where the Jacobian eigenvalues are λ_1=1 and λ_2=-1.

evidence.quote: In [2], the authors considered the Ricker competition model given by x_{n+1}=x_n e^{K-x_n-a y_n}, y_{n+1}=y_n e^{L-y_n-b x_n}, where (x,y) ∈ R_+^2. The parameters K, L > 0 are the carrying capacities of species x and y, respectively. Moreover, the competition parameters a and b are in the interval (0,1).
Open problem 1.5. (2) Determine the stability of the fixed point (0,L) when L = 2 and L = K/a. In this case, the eigenvalues of the Jacobian of the map of equation (1) are λ_1 = 1 and λ_2 = -1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the two-species Ricker competition map on the nonnegative quadrant $\mathbb{R}_+^2$ defined by
$$
x_{n+1} = x_n\, e^{K - x_n - a\, y_n}, \qquad y_{n+1} = y_n\, e^{L - y_n - b\, x_n},
$$
where $K, L > 0$ are the carrying capacities and $a, b \in (0,1)$ are competition coefficients. The point $(0, L)$ is a fixed point on the $y$-axis (an exclusion equilibrium). The Jacobian of the map at $(0, L)$ has eigenvalues
$$
\lambda_1 = e^{K - aL}, \qquad \lambda_2 = 1 - L.
$$
In the doubly nonhyperbolic boundary case where simultaneously
$$
L = 2 \quad \text{and} \quad L = K/a,
$$
so that $\lambda_1 = 1$ and $\lambda_2 = -1$, determine the stability type (stable, unstable, semi-stable, or otherwise) of the fixed point $(0, L)$ for the discrete dynamical system above.
